title: Learning to better use tools for development
author: Otterly_Delicious
selftext:
I've been working on a project, a management sim game. It started off just as an experiment in using AI, but it turned out to be more fun than expected to create and play. (Fun to me anyway, my target audience is me, so that's an relatively easy goal to hit). I'm really intrigued with the whole process, and I'd love to learn new and better way to use these tools.  

  
I've just been using the basic paid plans for Chatgpt and Claude, with Claude handling to the coding and ChatGPT handling the UI. I have a a GIT project that they both commit too, but mostly I'm just using the AI in standard desktop app chats. The only novel thing I believe I have done is to have Claude periodically do research and create a PDF I can mark up on my e-ink tablet - so while it's working on the next update, I can go over the game design direction sketch up art or UI ideas, and feed it back to Claude when I am done. 

  
What do you use? How do you like to plan and execute your projects?

  
Have you found good learning resources to get where you are today?
